source_cpu: macOS Apple M1, keyless, jobs=2; sampled process-tree RSS. CPU is cumulative CLI subprocess user+system time.

method.source_sample: Seed 2211; four fixed variant PDFs and two linked development PDFs in each of three classes. Sorted native paths, fixed schedule seed, neutral one-document folders.
method.R1: All pages rotated clockwise 90 degrees in original media box.
method.R2: All pages rotated clockwise 270 degrees in original media box.
method.R4: Last page rotated clockwise 90 degrees, with 1.5 degree skew on every page.
method.R5: Pixels rotated clockwise 90 degrees in a transposed media box with /Rotate 270, upright when displayed.
method.T1: One digit changed in the first NIP, KRS or bank account.
method.T2: The first two printed party-name words swapped and one character dropped. Six receipts have no printed party name, retain the faithful overlay, and remain in the denominator.
method.T3: All words joined on one invisible line.
method.T4: Invisible transcript of the next sampled document of the same class; visible pixels are unchanged.
method.render: 200 dpi grayscale; quarter-turns fit into the unchanged display page. Only R5 carries a rotation flag in transformed files.
method.wrong_nonnull_in_layer: Counts predicted non-null field/value pairs absent at that reference path and literally present in the hidden transcript, ignoring punctuation, whitespace and case. Text overlap is an upper bound on causal attribution.
method.wrong_ids_names: All extra non-null account, registry, PESEL and party/person name values; compared with each build’s source baseline. Counts use the repo leaf normalization.
method.scoring: Per-item exact JSON and routing with organizer UZP proxy, independently scored once per revision; byte comparison uses complete CLI JSONs. Positive scoring retains missing outputs in the denominator.
